Subject: Wavelytics — Renewal kickoff, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Alicia / Tom,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As we discussed, your annual renewal is coming up in July and you mentioned a likely commit uplift to support the new product search workload. I wanted to kick off the renewal coordination thread so we can align timelines, stakeholders, and lock a QBR slot.

Proposed high-level plan:
- Week of 5/19: mutual action plan (MAP) review + SOW draft to confirm scope (dedicated pool + private VPC option)
- Week of 6/2: legal & procurement redlines; pricing for 12-month vs 24-month term options
- Week of 6/16: exec QBR (finalize commit, review migration/throughput runbook)

Quick asks: can you confirm the target committed throughput (avg TPS and peak tokens/day) and whether the private deployment option is required for all production traffic or just analytics pipelines? That will influence headcount and GPU sizing.

I've attached a one-page MAP and a draft SOW (v1) for review. Marissa — can you add estimate ranges for a dedicated 8–16 GPU pool and a quantized 4–8 GPU alternative? David / Soojin — I'll loop you in on technical sizing once Alicia confirms the workload profile.

Available QBR windows (PST):
- Tue 6/16 10:00–11:00
- Wed 6/17 14:00–15:00
- Thu 6/18 08:30–09:30

Looking forward — Karthik

Attachments: Wavelytics_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_2025.xlsx, Wavelytics_SOW_v1.pdf

--

Subject: Re: Wavelytics — Renewal kickoff, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Target: currently hit ~3M tokens/day with spikes to ~12M on batch indexing days. For the next 12 months we expect ~2x growth, so planning to commit to a baseline that covers ~6M tokens/day with headroom for burst (peaks ~20M).
- Private deployment: core user-facing search must remain in our VPC due to data retention policy; analytics pipelines OK to route through hosted.

We can do the 6/17 14:00–15:00 slot. Also looping in our procurement lead Tom — he mentioned he will need the SOW and a simple license table for finance.

Alicia

Karthik / Marissa —

Confirmed on our side: 6/17 14:00 PST works. For procurement we need:
- Line-item SOW with per-month committed capacity and overage rates
- Pricing for 12 vs 24 month terms (we're sensitive to cash flow so a stepped/seasonal payment option would be good to see)
- Any standard security addenda / SOC-2 evidence links (we'll run these through our InfoSec review)

Marissa — can you put together a concise pricing worksheet and a short note on what the dedicated GPU pool includes (auto-burst, SLA tiers, support)? Also please confirm lead time for private VPC deployment and whether an on-prem option exists for analytics-only fallback.

Thanks — Tom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Brice <tom.brice@wavelytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-05-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wavelytics — Renewal kickoff, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Tom / Alicia,

Thanks — attaching a pricing worksheet (see attachment stub) that lays out:
- Committed tiers: 6M tokens/day baseline (12-month) vs 6M tokens/day baseline (24-month) with stepped discounts
- Dedicated pool SKU: 8-GPU standard (NVIDIA A100-equivalent) and quantized 4-GPU option for lower-cost inference for analytics jobs
- Overage: per-token rate + daily burst allowance; we can tier burst capacity if needed
- Payment: monthly, quarterly, or annual (with discount). We also included an amortized option to stage payment across quarters if that helps finance.

Private deployment lead time: 6–8 weeks from signed SOW for VPC integration (network workshop + KMS). On-prem analytics-only package: available as a separate addendum (3rd party appliance or partner-hosted) — I'll flag that as a separate line in the SOW.

David / Soojin — please add any technical prerequisites or runbook items you want covered in the QBR (network ports, expected latency, KV cache warmup plan).

Attachments: Wavelytics_PRICING_WORKSHEET_v1.xlsx

Best,
